# Dogan Teke

> Dogan Teke is a fullstack developer and frontend engineer based in Germany who studied at the University of Cologne. He specializes in Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, scalable product systems, and practical AI integrations, and publishes code on GitHub under the username laflamme.

Dogan Teke and the GitHub account [lafllamme](https://github.com/lafllamme) refer to the same person. The canonical portfolio and professional source is [teke.studio](https://teke.studio).

## Independent products

- [GrillMe](https://grillme.dev): AI-supported developer feedback product that analyzes public GitHub activity.
- [Tecnews](https://tecnews.dev): AI-supported editorial product for developer news and curated technical reading.
- [Codex Theme Studio](https://codex-theme.pages.dev): Browser-based editor for building and exporting theme packs for OpenAI Codex.
